string.text: What did you do with it, Marked One, hammer nails? That's not a knife anymore, it's a club... That needs a stone, not my hands. Go find a sharpener.
Were you digging with it? I won't take it. Find a sharpener, fix what you can yourself, then come back.
No. That's not a knife, that's a shovel. Find a sharpener, then bring it back.
Can you fix something for me?
Depends on what. I fix NATO hardware and Freedom armor, and I'll sort out knives. Show me.
I'm short on vodka right now. Later.
I'm busy right now. Come back later.
Nothing to fix for now. Just asking.
Hold on, take what I fixed first.
I'm short on cash right now. Later.
You've really worn this one out, Marked One... Straps frayed, buckle loose, pouches wobbling. Simple job: I'll restitch it and swap the rivets - you can take it right away. That'll be %s.
Here, good as new. Look after it - without a belt you won't carry many artifacts.
A belt? That's quick. Restitch the straps, tighten the mounts. I'll take %s.
A belt? Let me see... Straps are frayed, a couple of mounts are hanging by a thread. I'll do it right now while you wait. %s, as a favour.
Here's your belt. It won't let you down now.
